what: HEAD check omits explicit success return
scenario_or_breakage: When baseline and final HEAD differ, the function’s last command is the failing `[ … ]` test (exit 1), so `run_ci_fix_vendor` returns 1 even after a successful stage/push; `run_evaluate_failure` treats it as vendor failure instead of incrementing `FIX_ATTEMPTS`
suggested_fix: After the no-commit branch, add `return 0` (or `return` with captured `_stage_and_push_ci_fixes` rc)

what: HEAD check not gated on `_stage_and_push_ci_fixes` success
scenario_or_breakage: `ship-pr.sh` has no global `set -e`; if `_stage_and_push_ci_fixes` returns 1 (lint-fix-loop, push, etc.) but HEAD is unchanged, the new branch can still set `BAIL_REASON=first-fixer-non-health` and mask the real failure
suggested_fix: Only run the HEAD comparison when `_stage_and_push_ci_fixes` returns 0 (`if ! _stage_and_push_ci_fixes …; then return $?; fi` then HEAD check)

scenario_or_breakage: Default `write_state` has `TRANSIENT_RETRIES=0`, so `run_evaluate_failure` calls `ci-rerun-failed.sh` and may return before `run_ci_fix_vendor`; the new exit-3 case never runs
suggested_fix: Mirror sibling fix-loop cases: awk-patch state to `TRANSIENT_RETRIES=1` and `FAILED_RUN_ID=run3134` (or equivalent) before `run_subject`

scenario_or_breakage: `run_ci_fix_vendor` parses `LAUNCHER_EXIT` from launcher stdout redirected to `$fail_file`, not from `--output`
suggested_fix: Stub must print `LAUNCHER_EXIT=0` to stdout (default launcher stub pattern); `--output` is only for token-record

what: `make lint` failure claim targets wrong file
scenario_or_breakage: `lint-readability-preamble.sh` holds em-dash in a `grep -Ec` pattern, not `awk -v` or an awk-body regex; the new lint likely won’t flag that file on current `main`
suggested_fix: Revise testing strategy to name actual expected violators (post-#3144 awk sites) or drop the preamble claim

what: New lint wired only via `Makefile` / `make lint`
scenario_or_breakage: Sibling `lint-bare-grep-probe` is in pre-commit and `docs/linting.md`; commit-time / doc drift is possible but optional for minimum change
suggested_fix: Track follow-up: pre-commit hook + `docs/linting.md` row if parity with `lint-bare-grep-probe` is desired
